_README: Example Property_Only_Mode measurement. Copy, edit, and run:
npm run eval:property-only -- --config app/eval/property-only/property-only.config.example.json
THE CREDENTIAL DOES NOT BELONG IN THIS FILE, EVER.
It is read from the Credential_File alone, with no environment fallback, and there is
no config field that can hold it. A config file gets committed, pasted, and attached
to reports.
WHAT THIS MEASURES: per design, the Property_Author writes a Property_Set from the Spec
alone and that set is decided against the UNMODIFIED golden reference design. No
Testbench_Agent call and no Instrument_Admission step is in this path, and nothing here
can move a Formal_Verdict, a trust label, or a Fallback_Route on the student path. A key
whose NAME is shaped like one of those refuses the run by name.
THE COST_PILOT GATE: while no Per_Design_Extrapolation is recorded, NOTHING outside the
Cost_Pilot dispatches. Leave extrapolationFrom null for the first run; it dispatches the
three designs below against both Authoring_Models. Then point extrapolationFrom at this
run's own output directory and the next run covers the full population of 46, under an
Anomaly_Guard set at 10 times the MAXIMUM of the pilot's per-design figures.
COST: this runs real paid model calls. designs x authoringModels authoring calls, plus
one deterministic proof run per authored property. Cost is recorded as provenance and is
never a limiter; every declared limit names a reason that is not cost.
Prefix any key with "_" to use it as a comment.
_outputDir: Its own directory, named for the measurement, so no report of an end-to-end formal rate
reads it. The last segment must equal runName, and a directory already holding a sweep
_authoringModels: At least two, including both zai.glm-5 and moonshotai.kimi-k2.5: a property-only rate
from one model is a fact about that model rather than about the gate. A third model from
another family is a change to this list and nothing else.
_costPilotDesignIds: At most three, which is the declared cost-pilot-design-count. Pick typical designs and
not the heaviest ones: these figures set the ceiling the Anomaly_Guard is a multiple of.
_limits: The sandbox resource caps every proof runs under. Each proof's own wall clock comes from
the declared shipped Property_Time_Budget rather than from wallMs here.
_caps: The student-session caps one design's authoring is charged against. A fresh budget is
built per design, so no design's spend bounds another's.
_extrapolationFrom: The directory of an EARLIER property-only measurement this run reads its
Per_Design_Extrapolation from. null, absent, unreadable, or undecodable all mean no
extrapolation is recorded, which confines this run to the Cost_Pilot.
